title: A cyclic extension has a Kummer generator
statement: Let $E/F$ be a finite Galois field extension [def-pc-field-extension], [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] of degree $n\geq2$. Here Galois means normal and separable, normal meaning that every irreducible polynomial over $F$ with a root in $E$ splits over $E$. Suppose its automorphism group is cyclic (generated by one automorphism) and $F$ contains a primitive $n$th root of unity (an element of multiplicative order exactly $n$). Then there is $y\in E$ with $y^n\in F$ and $E=F(y)$, where $F(y)$ is the smallest subfield containing $F$ and $y$.
